meta.name: claw-monitor
meta.description: Use the `clawmonitor` CLI/TUI to inspect OpenClaw sessions, model health, token usage, and gateway service health.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 OpenClaw 会话与模型健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理 OpenClaw 服务并需要实时查看运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Inspect OpenClaw sessions and model health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage OpenClaw services and need real-time status

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以运行 clawmonitor 命令来查看 OpenClaw 会话状态、模型健康度、令牌用量和网关服务健康度，并以 Markdown 表格或 TUI 界面展示结果。
howto.when: 当用户询问代理是否完成、会话状态、模型故障或令牌消耗等问题时触发。

say.text: 检查我的代理是否还在运行？
哪个模型最近消耗令牌最多？
帮我看看有没有僵尸进程？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run the clawmonitor command to inspect OpenClaw sessions, model health, token usage, and gateway service health, outputting results as Markdown tables or in a TUI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about agent completion, session status, model failures, or token consumption.

say_en.text: Check if my agent is still running?
say_en.note: Claude runs clawmonitor status to view session state.

say_en.text: Which model burned the most tokens recently?
say_en.note: Claude runs clawmonitor models to check health and usage.
Claude runs clawmonitor tui to inspect system view.
